test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following wildlife sanctuaries is located in Goa?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhagwan Mahavir Wildlife Sanctuary**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhagwan Mahavir Wildlife Sanctuary is located in Goa**.

 
 
• **Bhagwan Mahavir Wildlife **Sanctuary is **located in Mollem town**.
 
• It is **one of the largest wildlife **sanctuaries in **Goa**.
 
• **Originally known **as the **Mollem Game Sanctuary **It was **declared **a **wildlife sanctuary in 1969 **and thence **renamed the Bhagwan Mahavir Wildlife Sanctuary**.
 
• The **sanctuary **is **heavily forested **and contains tropical evergreen forests, **semi-evergreen forests, and moist deciduous forests**.
